brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have cut off water supplies from an old well serving Balata, threatening over 12,000 residents with acute shortages, according to Shehab Wire. A newly drilled well cannot meet local demand, leaving the town facing a water crisis.

The halt compounds existing infrastructure challenges in the Palestinian community, which now relies on a single well unable to satisfy consumption needs.

title: Occupation halts water supply to Balata town of 12,000 residents
